description: Read the processing status of an event submitted with mba_send_agent_event. Status is one of request_received, processing, sent, failed, skipped or success; failed and skipped carry error_message and skipped_reason. This is the only way to find out whether an accepted event actually reached the consumer.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_agent_event

outputSchema.description: The current processing status of an agent event

created_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp at which the agent event was received

error_message.description:
Summary of failure, if event state is FAILED. One of: agent_not_enabled (the agent is turned off for this
phone number), agent_temporarily_unavailable (retry later), billing_not_configured (payment method missing or
billing details incomplete), consumer_not_in_agent_audience (consumer excluded by an allowlist or rollout),
event_content_rejected (the event text was declined), thread_not_owned_by_agent (another participant owns the
conversation), internal_server_error (any other failure)

event_type.description: The partner-defined event identifier supplied when the event was submitted, e.g. document_verified

skipped_reason.description: Summary of skip reason, if event state is SKIPPED

status.description: The current processing status of the agent event. Known values: request_received, processing, sent, failed, skipped, success.

updated_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp at which the agent event status was last updated

title: Read agent event status
